aliases.name: TRUMP OLD POST OFFICE LLC
aliases.notes: Item 095 of Part 2 Exhibit A. Form descriptor: 'Underlying Assets: hotel; Location: Washington, DC'. Same entity referenced as borrower on Part 8 item 13 (Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas loan, Over $50M).

notes: Hotel operating LLC for the Trump International Hotel at the Old Post Office building (1100 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC), held via The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust (cp_entity_0003). Subject of the GSA Old Post Office lease and the GSA OIG Report A170091/Q/4/P18004 (January 2019) referenced in PROJECT.md comparative case set. Cross-references the Ivanka OPO LLC chain on cp_filing_0001 / cp_filing_0004 (Ivanka's investment in this entity via Ivanka OPO LLC). Registered in Fork G as part of the Fork H prep set and the Over-$50M backfill (cp_rel_0355). The brand has been disposed since 2022 (sale to CGI Merchant Group, rebranded Waldorf Astoria) but preserve as observed_on the cp_filing_0003 date.
